tasks.setup:
mkdir -p $HOME/Documents; python3 - <<'PY'
import zlib
pages=3
objs=[]
kids=' '.join(f'{3+i*2} 0 R' for i in range(pages))
objs.append('<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>')
objs.append(f'<< /Type /Pages /Kids [{kids}] /Count {pages} >>')
for i in range(pages):
    objs.append(f'<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 300 300] /Contents {4+i*2} 0 R /Resources << /Font << /F1 << /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >> >> >> >>')
    s=f'BT /F1 24 Tf 40 150 Td (Page {i+1}) Tj ET'
    objs.append(f'<< /Length {len(s)} >>\nstream\n{s}\nendstream')
import os
out='%PDF-1.4\n'; offs=[]
for n,o in enumerate(objs,1):
    offs.append(len(out)); out+=f'{n} 0 obj\n{o}\nendobj\n'
x=len(out); out+=f'xref\n0 {len(objs)+1}\n0000000000 65535 f \n'+''.join(f'{o:010d} 00000 n \n' for o in offs)
out+=f'trailer\n<< /Size {len(objs)+1} /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n{x}\n%%EOF\n'
open(os.environ['HOME']+'/Documents/guide.pdf','w').write(out)
PY
start evince $HOME/Documents/guide.pdf
tasks.prompt: In the open document viewer showing guide.pdf, go to page 3, then close the viewer.
